title: Chapter 521
paragraphs: Chapter 521
Episode 143. Attribute Training (2)

"Sigh... Am I being treated unfairly again? I thought it would take at least two months to master a light-speed thrust with this level of perfection, even with my attribute training. But it didn't even take a day, not even an hour."
It was not easy for Talris to understand.

In fact, it was absurd to master a high-quality light-speed thrust in just two months. He simply thought that it would be possible in that time frame when Jin's potential and his own assistance were combined.
"...You did it all at once?"
Jin looked startled by Talris's reaction.
Considering he managed it quite easily, he naturally thought that Talris would have predicted this level of success.
'Is it really that surprising?'
First, he lightly bowed in apology for interrupting Talris's words and unsheathing his sword.
"I'm sorry, I did it without realizing."
"No, is that what's important right now? Son-in-law, what is this? Have you been practicing this technique before?"
"It's been a few days."
"Ahaha, so that's what it is..."
Somehow, he was reminded of the time when he first learned magic from Murakan in his turbulent days. Talris was showing the same reaction as Murakan, who was always shocked by Jin's talent.

"Well, I must say I chose a good son-in-law. It's a waste of talent to keep you as the owner of the maze. The second generation, Joshua, has also fallen into the abyss... Hmm, maybe I should make you the head of the Runcandel family? There's no history of marriage between the family head and the maze owner, but we can create one now."
When he learned magic from Murakan, he deliberately showed lower skills to avoid suspicion and controlled his progress. Now, there was no need for that.
"I think I can split the acceleration... not into seven parts, but into nine."
"What did you say?"

"To be precise, I should say divide it into three. I consider three sets of nine aura concentrations as one acceleration. If I get the sense of accelerating three times like this, it will become a proper thrust."
At that point, Talris was shocked again.
'There was a somewhat cryptic part in the manuscript left by Shiron... could it mean what my son-in-law is saying now...! I thought it was just a device for Meri.'
Quickly revisiting the manuscript, Talris was able to confirm that Jin's words were exactly correct.
"You said your sister's light-speed thrust is inferior to mine?"
"Yes."

"Then Meri should not have passed this on to you. She wouldn't have grasped the secret. She might think the reason her light-speed thrust is inferior to Shiron's is just due to the difference in achievement and proficiency."
"Meri will find the answer herself someday."
"Hmm, that child is certainly special, so she probably will."
However, compared to you, even that tremendous talent seems to fade. Talris held back his follow-up words.
"Anyway, I think I understand when the nine aura concentration points are. But showing it again makes my feet hurt. Try again, once more."
"I think I need some preparatory actions."
"Slowly, stab as perfectly as possible."
Jin concentrated and adjusted his posture.
And the light-speed thrust he deployed seemed to... reveal a power surpassing the sword Talris initially showed.
However, the aura bound to the sword failed to stretch forward forcefully and continued to shatter pitifully. The stance he took to thrust also crumbled, nearly causing him to fall forward.
"Ahahaha! After surprising this mother-in-law just now, is it now time to make me laugh?"
With Talris laughing like that, Jin couldn't help feeling a bit awkward.
"Maybe I was too greedy, my center fell apart. It was a shameful sight."
"Yes, you need to show such human aspects too. Thanks to that, I had a good laugh."
However, contrary to his words, Talris did not forget the fact that Jin 'almost succeeded again'.
'He was so focused on the aura procession that he lost his basic posture at the last moment. In effect, he almost did it in one try again... He'll definitely succeed if he tries again.'
Jin took his stance again.
Talris quietly waited for him to unsheath his sword.
Jin, with a changed look in his eyes, reviewed the mistake he just made and pulled up his aura.
The single stroke that ripped the empty air and spewed radiance contained the dignity worthy of being called Runcandel's 'special technique'.
Runcandel's 5th Special Technique
Light-Speed Thrust!
A blinding flash flickered. Following the speed of that flash, the stretched black space distorted sharply, leaving a long afterimage like a comet's tail.

Only those who have reached the ultimate state can see the afterimage of that instant. The line of aura that started from the sword and moved forward after the action was over because it rushed into the trajectory pointed by the sword like crazy.
A huge cavity formed in the ice wall of the training field. If Talris hadn't strengthened it in advance with the power of ice, Jin's aura would have gone beyond the maze and left its mark in the sky.
Now, instead of being surprised or shocked, Talris expressed pure admiration.
"Wow, I don't know about the speed, but the power certainly surpasses what I demonstrated."
Jin, who finished the special technique, bowed his head while catching his breath.
"Your demonstration was merely a light display. In any aspect, my sword cannot dare to compare with Master Talris's martial arts."
"No, it's the same even if you fully deploy it. There's a limit to reproducing it since it's a special technique unique to Runcandel. And... hmm."
"Why do you say that?"
"Nine times..."
Talris was feeling as though he had just encountered a new realm of that technique, having witnessed Jin's light-speed thrust.
"Could the aura concentration be divided into ten times?"
Jin intuitively realized why Talris was saying such a thing.
"Do you see the potential for improvement?"

"Hmm, improvement... From the beginning, the light-speed thrust is clearly a complete form with the nine concentrations and three accelerations you mentioned. However, you are not a typical martial artist, are you?"
Soul energy, brain energy, and magic power.
Unlike a typical martial artist, Jin can use four types of power, including aura. And Talris judged that perhaps one of these powers could act as the 'tenth element' of the light-speed thrust.
People generally do not question something that is already in a perfect form. The same goes for the sword.
But Talris was also not an ordinary martial artist like Jin.

"There are several extremely fast thrusts and cuts in our Bigung martial arts. And all those swords supplement aura procession with the power of ice. I think the same method can be applied to the light-speed thrust. No, I'm almost certain. Those who only use aura cannot think of this."
Jin felt a chill run down the back of his neck. It was a moment of enlightenment.

"Of course, this won't apply to all kinds of swords, but because of its simplicity, it won't be difficult to add power to the light-speed thrust. And in my opinion, it would be best to add brain energy."
Some of Runcandel's decisive techniques and special techniques have their origin in the King's Sword.
Although the light-speed thrust is a sword formed independently by Runcandel, fundamentally, there must be an influence from the King's Sword when tracing back to its origins.
Of course, Talris doesn't know this fact. The suggestion to add brain energy was purely derived from the insight of a martial artist who has reached the extreme state.
"It will surely fit well. Now, what you and I need to do is find the last point of acceleration. It will be a great sword. We should give it your name too."
"I didn't do anything."
"Hmm, I know. But I can't put my name on it, right? Consider it a reward for making me laugh, Heuktaeja."
"I'm considering how to kill the pirate who first gave me that nickname."
Thus, two weeks passed since Jin and Talris began their training.
With each passing day, Kinzelo cursed at Jin, who still hadn't notified him of the meeting date, while Runcandel and Ziephel were conducting a media war controlling information about the Sota Desert.
And dark rumors about Joshua began to circulate in the world.
Runcandel had never issued an official stance on his downfall.
But even without it, the general public could infer Joshua's dismissal, and open secrets were only formed everywhere.

However, the media, which was still pro-Joshua, were subtly publishing articles protecting him. They claimed the rumors of his dismissal were unfounded, and he had merely entered a period of secluded training.
Rosa didn't particularly try to stop them.
"Heh! Now our master is practically the next ruler of Runcandel, and yet there are still talks of the second successor taking the throne. It's frustrating. His time is over."
Jet spoke as he closed the newsletter.
"Jet, you mustn't talk like this elsewhere."
"Sir Casimir, I'm not that foolish, hehe. By the way, our master went out to learn something for a few hours that day, and there has been no news for half a month now... I'm worried."
"You worry about everything. Is it because you don't know how much Master Talris cherishes the boy?"
"That's not it. I just miss our master. If I were born as a true martial artist, I would have fought with him every time. Right, Enya?"
"Absolutely, Uncle Jet! You should try training every day like me, you never know? Hidden talent might awaken."
"Heh, dreams are for youngsters like you."
"Uncle Jet, you're going soft."
The other colleagues nearby let out a snicker.
However, leaders like Casimir, Balkas, and Lata soon turned serious.
"Swordsmen. I think we need to report this to the lord."
In front of the table where they sat, there were stacks of newsletters and reports from the Rainbow Bird and the Ghost Corps.
"I agree with you, Sir Balkas."

"I have seen how much our lord cherishes him. Of course, it doesn't seem like anything will happen immediately, but I still think we should let him know sooner rather than later. I have a bad feeling."
The report they were reading contained the following:

(Confirmed signs of low-level purge: All Dragon Knights' dragons are gathering in the Imperial Palace. There's a possibility that it is more than a simple check by the emperor, given various circumstances.
The whereabouts of the Dragon Knights cannot be determined with the current level of intelligence.
The risk of exposure is very, very high if the intelligence level is raised, hence the approval from the Tikkan headquarters is required.)
